ONE_SENTENCE_PITCH: Accept synthetic pain.001 uploads over SFTP and return configurable pain.002 acknowledgements.
QUICK_START_SNIPPET:
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -f ./mock_host_key
# Set MOCKBANK_PASSWORD in your shell to a test-only secret first.
poetry run pain001-mockbank --host-key ./mock_host_key --username synthetic
QUICK_START_EXPLANATION: The server listens on 127.0.0.1:2222. Upload synthetic XML into /inbox; read acknowledgements from /outbox. Compare the host key with the locally generated public key before connecting.
CAPABILITY_DESCRIPTION: SFTP upload, conditional ACCP/RJCT/PDNG replies and optional REST history
FEATURES_CONTENT: Authenticated SFTP, explicit host keys, exclusive uploads, bounded mailbox storage, deterministic rule selection and pain.002 serialization delegated to core.
CONFIGURATION_CONTENT: Use --rules for a YAML policy, --root for mailbox storage, --inbox/--outbox/--archive for simple directory names, and --rest-port to enable optional local reply history. Run --help for the generated option reference.
EXAMPLES_CONTENT: [upload_and_collect.py](examples/upload_and_collect.py) starts the bank in process, uploads a payment under the example rules' limit and one over it, and prints ACCP and RJCT. Run it with `poetry run python examples/upload_and_collect.py`. [rules.yaml](examples/rules.yaml) is the rules file it uses; the [container guide](docs/usage.md) runs the image.
LIMITATIONS_CONTENT: Do not use for real payments, settlement simulation, production bank authentication, or mixed-currency total calculations. It is a test fixture, not a bank.
SECURITY_CONTENT: Use only synthetic data. Credentials and host keys are explicit; bind to loopback and do not expose the optional unauthenticated REST view publicly. YAML has no executable expressions, XML DTDs are refused, and uploads are limited to 8 MiB. The project holds the [OpenSSF Best Practices passing badge](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/16559).
ADDITIONAL_INSTALL_METHODS:
Each pain001 suite release, from 0.0.81, publishes a versioned image for
linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, signed with cosign and never moved:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/sebastienrousseau/pain001-mockbank:0.0.87
```

The release's `image.txt` names it by digest. Development images are
also published: `edge` moves on main/feature pushes after checks, and
`sha-<full-commit-id>` addresses one commit. See [container configuration](docs/usage.md); explicit host keys,
test credentials and mailbox storage are still required.
DEMO_ALT_TEXT: pain001-mockbank --help, then examples/upload_and_collect.py uploading two synthetic payments over SFTP and printing ACCP and RJCT
